integrity: The proof derives the true-twin cells directly from the chain-ideal decomposition, proves that the support quotient has automorphism group \(S_r\), then computes the weighted lift, determining number, and distinguishing number. The standalone verifier exhausts the seven-vertex automorphism group, brute-forces small determining numbers, verifies explicit distinguishing colorings, and reconstructs two integer-residue examples directly from divisor ideals.
scientific_limitations: Every local factor is required to have nilpotency length \(\ell_i\ge2\); mixed products with field factors are not covered.
The graph automorphism group is computed, not the image of \(\operatorname{Aut}(R)\).
The formulas depend on the local nilpotency lengths and are insensitive to residue-field orders.
title: Symmetry breaking in ideal-intersection graphs of fully nonreduced finite principal ideal rings
